source: Colours from MODONTY/creative/brand/brand-colors.md and modonty/app/globals.css; font from modonty/app/layout.tsx (Tajawal). Read 16 Oct 2026.

colors.rule: Navy dominates, blue for emphasis boxes, teal one thin touch only. Three colours maximum. Gold is not part of the identity.

captions.style: Tajawal 800, white, navy stroke 6px, soft shadow
captions.no_inline_colour: Never a colour override mid-line in Arabic (libass scrambles run order). Emphasis = own line or a blue box behind the whole line.

safe_area_short.note: Conservative, not an official YouTube number: YouTube documents a right-side button panel and truncated description text, but publishes no pixel safe zone.

logo.lockup: Co-brand on every frame: Modonty icon (right, reads first) | thin white divider | client logo as a rounded tile (left). Client logo from the article's JSON-LD logo.contentUrl. End card: both logos large with a teal × between.

credit.style: trust shield + client/doctor name, white 36, 70% opacity

chapter_card.content: teal chapter number, series name Tajawal 900 120px, chapter title 54px

end_screen.keep_clear: left half for YouTube end-screen elements (5-20 s in Studio)

thumbnail.layout: navy right half with max 3 words Tajawal 900, article image left half, logo corner

motion.beat_transition: blue wipe right-to-left, 6 frames, Modonty icon passes on the wipe edge

voice.name: Modonty Saudi Narrator — designed voice, Najdi Saudi, ~30, warm and energetic YouTube host
voice.style: none (the designed voice carries the dialect; a style annotation added nothing)
voice.expiry: Stored voice, 1-year TTL from last use (first expiry shown 2027-10-16). If it is ever gone, recreate from the prompt in engine/gemini_voice.py history: POST /v1beta/voices {store:true, voice:{type:'prompted', prompted:{input:<description>}}}
voice.key: GEMINI_API_KEY from env, else MODONTY/console/.env.local. Never print it.
voice.rate_limits: 429 and read timeouts happen on long runs; engine retries with backoff (15 s steps, 8 tries) and caches every beat by text hash.
voice.rejected: Azure ar-SA Hamed/Zariyah ('very bad'), ElevenLabs and MiniMax presets via Higgsfield (not convincing), Gemini prebuilt ar-001 voices (MSA).
voice.doctor: The doctor's own voice when a clip exists.

audio.script_for_voice: Write white Saudi dialect the way it is said, then add tashkeel only where a TTS would misread: وِش · بَشوف · بِنعرف · مُخّك · هَمّ · shadda on every doubled letter (تقلّب، تسوّي). Avoid contractions TTS stumbles on (هالمقاطع → هذي المقاطع). Short sentences, commas for breath.
audio.music: Changes every video, from the YouTube Audio Library, ducked to -22 LUFS under voice. Never the same track across the series.
audio.sonic_logo: Same 1.2 s Modonty sting on every end card — the one audio element that never changes.

end_card.background: navy over the blurred article image

disclosure: Tick YouTube 'altered or synthetic content' when the voice is synthetic.
